name: Recollect
source:
You would like to remember old memories? What is behind those blocked memories?  

Recollect is a collection of stories. Each story is short and it can be about fantasy, sci-fi, old tales or any tales. With your answers, you can find multiple endings, but always with some good side to learn.

[From [url=https://faylart.itch.io/recollect]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你想起过去的回忆了吗？那些被封存的记忆背后究竟藏着什么？

《Recollect》是一部故事集。每个故事都很短，题材可能是奇幻、科幻、古老传说或其他故事。你的回答会引向多个结局，但每个故事总能带来一些值得学习的东西。

[来源：[url=https://faylart.itch.io/recollect]Itch.io[/url]]
